$FREF$ = <ref>The firerate assumes that the axe returns on time.</ref>

$MDREF$ = <ref>DPS assumes that it can hit as many times as its Bounces stat, bouncing among up to Max Targets enemies, and that the axe takes the longest time possible to return and move between targets.<br/>Throw damage is the series Damage, Damage + Added Damage, … for Bounces hits.<br/>DPS is calculated as (Bounces × (2 × Damage + (Bounces − 1) × Added Damage) ÷ 2) ÷ (Firerate + Windup + Catch Time + Max Flight Time × Bounces + Max Return Time)</ref>
$R$ = $FNC-RECURSION$
